title: Avoid id collisions.
body:
Right now we use facets as ID's for internal widget identification. This might break when a facet is named with the same name as a static id (like pager / sortBy and so on).

Proposed solution: namespace the name of the facet with a key specific to the type of widget.

comments.body: This is a discussion that could start drafting the shape of the eventual instantsearch-core.
